NIKS_SHARED_NPC_INITIATIVE.ToggleTooltip: Enable/Disable shared initiative for NPCs of the same type in this combat.
NIKS_SHARED_NPC_INITIATIVE.EnabledByDefa: Whether "Group NPC Initiative" starts switched on for newly created combats. Existing combats keep their current toggle.
NIKS_SHARED_NPC_INITIATIVE.GroupByHint: Which NPCs share an initiative value. "Base actor" groups all tokens made from the same sidebar actor. "Base actor and initiative bonus" additionally splits off tokens whose initiative bonus differs (e.g. a boss variant). "Combatant name" groups NPCs with identical names, even across different actors.
NIKS_SHARED_NPC_INITIATIVE.ApplyInitiati: Automatically apply the current initiative of other combatants of the same actor type to any new combatant added to the combattracker.
NIKS_SHARED_NPC_INITIATIVE.DebugHint: If enabled, the module will print debug information to the console.
